invariants: GitHub-hosted Actions is optional CI redundancy and is never sufficient execution truth by itself.
No execution adapter means BLOCKED, never SUCCEEDED.
The observed artifact digest must match the MetaForge artifact digest.
A proof URI is required for successful execution evidence.
Credentials must not be serialized into receipts.
Alternate executors do not change canonical source ownership.
Observed execution does not bypass DevOS, PROMETHEUS, SECA, Medusa, ProofGrid, or Thoth.
promotion_rule: Promotion is forbidden unless execution.status=SUCCEEDED, evidenceClass is admissible, artifactDigestVerified=true, DevOS/SECA pass, Medusa allows, ProofGrid publishes, and Thoth archives.
